reason: The hypothesis synthesizes the specific finding from P41 that electronegativity and local chemical fluctuations contribute to phonon scattering with the general concept of using atomistic descriptors in a predictive model. It proposes a new, non-trivial integration: calibrating a learning-based model on these multi-scale descriptors (strain, bonding, electronegativity) to predict low thermal conductivity in new HEAs, which no passage proposes or does. The 20% improvement benchmark and the falsification test are also new.

lattice distortion reduces thermal conductivity (P8, P4, P13, P24, P35)
